stable.notes: The Session Pet stays where you park it. Opening a list grows the panel upward, and when that would run past the top of the screen macOS slides the panel down to keep it visible — the pet then treated that slid position as its new home, so closing the list left it lower than it started. A pet parked high on screen walked 450 points down in a single open. Frames are now rebuilt from the spot you dragged it to, so a slide is temporary and closing returns it exactly; dragging still re-parks it. The live activity line is also a news ticker now: a long summary scrolls through a fixed window at a steady reading pace so you can see what an agent is actually doing, text that already fits never moves, a new summary restarts from the beginning, and Reduced Motion keeps it still. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
